deadline.value: International applicants: May 1 for September 2027 (four months before start), including references; apply earlier for entrance scholarships.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT taken on/after 21 Jan 2026: 5 overall with at least 4.5 per skill (older tests: 95 with 21 per skill).
toefl_min.quote: For tests written on or after January 21, 2026: A minimum overall score of 5 with a minimum of 4.5 on each individual skill area.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: A minimum overall band score of 7.0 with a minimum of 6.5 in each band.

english_waiver.value: No test needed if your institution is on the GPS exemption list, or if it teaches in English and sends an official letter directly to NMHI.
english_waiver.quote: Their institution's language of instruction is English. An official letter stating that this is the case must be sent from the institution directly to the Neuroscience and Mental Health Institute.

supervisor.value: Secure a supervisor and funding before starting the application.
supervisor.quote: applicants must first have a supervisor and funding in place before they begin their application

funding.value: Funding must be confirmed by your supervisor before you apply; U of A guarantees at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4.
funding.quote: A supervisor and funding has been secured.

also.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: Master's holders are considered for direct PhD entry; others normally start in the MSc.
entry_route.quote: Students who already possess a Master's degree in an appropriate subject will be considered for entry into the PhD program.

notes: Minimum GPA 3.0/4 over last two years.
